readout_other: conditioned place preference; motor activity scoring; SpO2, heart and respiratory rate; H&E, VAF-toluidine blue, GFAP and caspase-3 histology
direction_notes: Verum tFUS to the nAcc, using a parameter set the authors describe as suppressive, reduced the fentanyl-induced CPP score relative to post-conditioning and to sham.
safety_notes: Vital signs did not differ between verum and sham; histology (H&E, VAF-toluidine blue, GFAP, caspase-3) at up to 4 weeks showed no tissue damage in the sonicated region.

device.model: single-element 600 kHz PZT transducer with polyetherimide acoustic lens

timing.protocol_description: 0.5 ms pulse duration at 100 Hz PRF at 5 W/cm2 Isppa, delivered to the nAcc for 30 min under isoflurane anaesthesia; verum and sham sessions in randomised order about 2 h apart on day 5 after 4 days of fentanyl conditioning.

source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The sequence of verum and sham tFUS intervention was randomized and balanced, each followed by post-intervention CPP evaluation that occurred \~1-hr after the full recovery from the anesthesia.

flags.reason: Duration given as 30 min of delivery; the within-session on/off structure of the 30 min is not stated beyond the pulse parameters, so 1800 s is recorded as stated duration of delivery.
Pressure 0.38 MPa and Isppa 5 W/cm2 are not explicitly assigned to water or brain; field was mapped in degassed water but the sentence does not say the values are free-field.
Paper gives 250 mW/cm2; converted to W/cm2 only.
Verum and sham interventions were both given on day 5 about 2 h apart; recorded as 2 interventions per animal.
Only the video raters are stated to be blinded to the sequence; treatment was not blinded to the operator.
